name: command-force-push-a-branch-and-its-tag
why: The same two refs, force-pushed: every part is one an allow names, and one part is also what the deny forbids, which wins.

job.purpose: git push origin fix-43 v1.2.0 to github.com/acme/web: push my branch fix-43 and its release tag v1.2.0; never force-push

statements: allow push on branch "fix-43" in repository "acme/web"
allow push on tag "v1.2.0" in repository "acme/web"
deny force-push on anything in anywhere

definitions.force-push: Push a ref so that commits it pointed at are no longer on it: git push --force, --force-with-lease, or a refspec beginning with +.
definitions.push: Update a ref on the remote with git push: create it or move it forward.
